newsitem.title: USA: Playboy seeks new delay in US TV decency law.
newsitem.headline: Playboy seeks new delay in US TV decency law.

text.p: Playboy Entertainment Group Inc and Graff Pay-Per-View Inc went to court Tuesday seeking further delays in enforcement of a law that tightens limits on sexually explicit programming.

A recent court order allows the U.S. government to proceed with enforcement of the law, which has been on hold since March. Playboy attorney Robert Corn-Revere told Reuters that Playboy and Graff appealed the order directly to the U.S. Supreme Court on Friday. Today's filing, he said, seeks a stay of the court order pending that appeal.
